scope: Exposition references support science only; official syllabus-row fidelity and extension eligibility HOLD

claims.claim: Total momentum changes by net external impulse; internal action-reaction impulses cancel for the chosen system.
claims.warrant: Sum Newton's impulse relation for both bodies in a common inertial frame.
claims.obligation: Demonstrate different individual velocities, signed system momentum and external impulse boundary.

claims.locator: §8.3 Elastic and Inelastic Collisions, perfectly inelastic collision
claims.claim: A latching pair shares one velocity; the isolated momentum equation determines it, not kinetic-energy conservation.
claims.warrant: Insert the common velocity into both momentum and kinetic energy expressions; subtract to derive reduced-mass identity.
claims.obligation: Teach opposing momentum and loss ledger; test zero relative velocity and cancellation.

claims.claim: Net work changes kinetic energy; work and impulse are distinct.
claims.warrant: Constant horizontal friction integrates over distance, ideal radial tension does no work on a constrained bob.
claims.obligation: Teach sliding assumptions, force arrows and swing height separately from contact.
